shortAnswer: Virginia law lists several ways identity may be confirmed for electronic notarization. The biometric language appears inside one statutory option tied to a valid digital certificate accessed by biometric data or PIV-style credentials; it should not be treated as a generic label for platform selfie, liveness, or face-match checks.
exactVirginiaCodeSignal: Virginia Code section 47.1-2 includes a listed option for a valid digital certificate accessed by biometric data or by use of an interoperable Personal Identity Verification card.
